currentCard.explanation: Худи — это толстовка с капюшоном. Футболка обычно не имеет воротника и бывает с короткими рукавами, а рубашка обычно имеет воротник и передний разрез.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: HOODIE L38 and L96 explicitly define hoodie as a hooded sweatshirt, exactly the object named in the question. This is a naming question for a sweatshirt-with-hood, not a generic question asking which garment can have any hood. T-shirt and shirt are different conventional garment names; sweater is the knitted/crocheted jacket/pullover category (L46), not the conventional name of the named sweatshirt. A hooded shirt or sweater does not thereby become a sweatshirt. Thus the row has one conventional answer Худи; no absence-of-hood inference from other entries is required.
